title: Cheapest Gyms Hamilton
meta_desc: Find the most affordable gym options in Hamilton, NZ. Compare prices, no-contract alternatives, and discover how to get 40-70% off with Exercise NZ subsidy.
intro: Hamilton's gym scene has grown significantly, offering good value for money compared to main centres. City Fitness and Les Mills operate here, along with several boutique studios. We've rounded up the cheapest gym options in Hamilton, including no-contract alternatives and the Exercise NZ subsidy programme.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Options
sections.body: The most affordable gym option in Hamilton is City Fitness, with a month-to-month membership for $18.99/week. Other budget-friendly options include Jetts, with a no-contract membership and a current promotion of 15% off + 4 weeks free, and Snap Fitness, offering 6 weeks free. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme provides the biggest discount available, with 40-70% off for eligible members.
list: Jetts: no-contract membership with 15% off + 4 weeks free

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives
sections.body: For those who prefer flexibility, Jetts offers a no-contract membership. Les Mills also has a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract. These options provide the freedom to cancel or change memberships without being tied to a long-term contract.
list: Les Mills: Flexi Membership (no lock-in contract)

sections.heading: Exercise NZ Subsidy Programme
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy programme is a great way to make gym memberships more affordable. With the subsidy, members can enjoy significant discounts on their gym membership, making it more accessible to those who may not have been able to afford it otherwise.
